notes: CHK-003 uses a single pending-request register (assumes one outstanding TL-UL request, in-order D beat). Credit = accepted qualifying writes minus those whose D beat had o_d_error=1, compared with alerts counted including the current edge. The 16-edge bound is enforced via an age counter since the last qualifying error-free D beat; alerts are also allowed while a qualifying write is still pending or accepted on that edge. There are no parameters, so the base configuration is the only one.
